about_the_game:
HYPURRX IS A GRITTY SPEED RUN, CUTE-EM-UP, BULLET HELL ARCADE GAME!

Pilot your cat companion through a brutal onslaught of enemy waves and epic boss battles.

The Klaudr Bell raceway offers elite pilots a variety of play styles and meowchievements to attain.

You will have the opportunity to prove yourself on track and climb the global championship leaderboards in this single player, arcade-style vertical shooter.

▼ High-Speed Bullet Hell Mayhem!

The HypurrX League is the galaxy’s most dangerous and exhilarating hover-racing spectacle—where high-speed combat meets pulse-pounding competition.

In the depths of space, on tracks that defy gravity, you’ll dodge, weave, and blast your way through relentless enemy waves, deadly obstacles, and towering boss encounters.

But this isn’t just a race—it’s survival.

In the orbit of Klaudr Bell, the first leg of the tournament is about to begin.

The best pilots from across the system are here to prove themselves, gunning for fame, fortune, and corporate sponsorships.

The stakes are sky-high, and the track itself is a battlefield. Whether you’re outmaneuvering high-speed hazards, taking down rogue enemies, or chasing the perfect score, one thing is certain—nobody crosses the finish line unscathed.

▼ Features:

  • Feline Heroes with Attitude – Register your own pet or follow the story of Usui, a skilled pilot with lightning reflexes, a sharp tongue, and a lot to prove.
  • Bullet Hell Racing Combat – Fast, fluid, and furious! Dodge enemy fire while blasting your way through the HypurrX raceway.
  • Meowchievements – Each track has rewards available for completing challenges as you race. Collect them all for the ultimate glory.
  • Ship and Weapon System Upgrades – Tune your ship to your playstyle with deep customization options for your engines, firepower and gear you can take to the track.
  • Epic Boss Fights – Face off against massive mechanical guardians and ruthless challengers who want you off the track—permanently.
  • Global Leaderboards – Chase high scores, dominate the competition, and prove you’re the ultimate pilot.

▼ Are You Fast Enough? Are You Fierce Enough?

Join Captain Usui as an enforcer on patrol for M.E.O.W the Mach Eight Orbital Watch.
Feline pilots with a need for speed and an appetite for action will stand and fight -defending the raceways from the invading Mischuhf Brigade: Rat Pirates led by general Osgoods.

Create your Cat Pilot. Customize your ship and styles, and head to the raceways to earn Creds. You will need to fully maximize your loadout to get the perfect scores in the trenches while dealing with the rat mecha pirates.

Prove yourself on track and climb the global championship leaderboards!

The galaxy is watching. The race is on. And in the HypurrX League, only the boldest survive.
Jump into the cockpit and show them what you’re made of!

▼ About Us

HypurrX is developed by an indie team Buko Studios! High Flying Filipino developers in metro manila headed by wife and husband founders Cherry and Kevin Boase!
We are a studio of 30 that have been together for years with credits on award winning vr and mobile titles. This will be our first original IP in the HypurrX universe!
Thank you all for your support!

ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
